name: Mirage
description: You mark an area with a very short (5 unit) radius centered on a point you touch. While you are within the area and concentrating, you can use an action to alter one aspect of the environment (a wall, the floor, a doorway, furniture, lighting, sounds, smells). Each alteration affects sight, sound, smell, and touch. Alterations persist until you change them or the spell ends. A creature can see through an individual alteration if their senses or logic beats your original spell check. Leaving the area or losing concentration ends the spell.
charge: The radius increases to short (10 units). The illusion no longer ends if you leave the area. If the mirage remains uninterrupted and you concentrate for at least 1 hour, it becomes permanent until dispelled by magic that removes illusions.
